{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique())

# Confirm if all are strings with commas
print("\nAre all revenue values strings?", sales['revenue'].dtype == 'object')

# Check for the presence of commas
print("\nAny revenue values contain commas?", sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())"}
